thi-ap33:1.1: Nagare Aruṇavatiyā Aruṇo nāma khattiyo / tassa rañño ahaṃ bhariyā ekaccaṃ vādayām' ahaṃ // //
thi-ap33:2.1: Rahogatā nisīditvā evaṃ cintes' ahaṃ tadā: / kusalaṃ me kataṃ n' atthi ādāya gamiyam mama. // //
thi-ap33:3.1: Mahābhitāpaṃ kaṭukaṃ ghorarūpaṃ sudāruṇaṃ / nirayaṃ nūna gacchāmi ettha me n' atthi saṃsayo. // //
thi-ap33:4.1: Evāhaṃ cintayitvāna pahaṃsetvāna mānasaṃ / rājānaṃ upagantvā va imaṃ vacanam abraviṃ: // //
thi-ap33:5.1: Itthī nāma mayaṃ deva purisānaṃ bharā mayaṃ / ekam me samaṇaṃ dehi bhojayissāmi khattiya. // //
thi-ap33:6.1: Adāsi me tadā rājā samaṇaṃ bhāvitindriyaṃ / tassa pattaṃ gahetvāna paramannena pūrayiṃ. // //
thi-ap33:7.1: Pūretvā paramaṃ annaṃ sahassaṃ gandhalepanaṃ / mahānelena chādetvā adāsiṃ 'tuṭṭhamānasā. // //
thi-ap33:8.1: Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca / jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsaṃ agacch' ahaṃ. // //
thi-ap33:9.1: Sahassaṃ devarājānaṃ mahesittam akārayiṃ / sahassaṃ cakkavattīnaṃ mahesittam akārayiṃ. // //
thi-ap33:10.1: Padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ / nānāvidhaṃ bahuṃ puññaṃ tassa kammassa phalaṃ tato. // //
thi-ap33:11.1: Uppalass' eva me vaṇṇo abhirūpā sudassanā / itthi sabbaṅgasampannā abhijātā jutiṇḍharā. // //
thi-ap33:12.1: Pacchime bhavasampatte ajāyiṃ Sākiye kule / nārīsahassapāmokkhā Suddhodana-sutass' ahaṃ. // //
thi-ap33:13.1: Nibbinditvā agāre 'haṃ pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ / sattamīratti appattā catusaccaṃ apāpuṇiṃ. // //
thi-ap33:14.1: Cīvaraṃ piṇḍapātañ ca paccayaṃ sayanāsanaṃ / parimetuṃ na sakkomi piṇḍapātass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
thi-ap33:15.1: Yaṃ mayhaṃ purimaṃ kammaṃ kusalaṃ sarase mune / tuyh' atthāya mahāvīra pariccattaṃ bahuṃ mama. // //
thi-ap33:16.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi piṇḍapātass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
thi-ap33:17.1: Duve gatī pajānāmi devattaṃ atha mānusaṃ / aññaṃ gatiṃ na jānāmi piṇḍapātass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
thi-ap33:18.1: Ucce kule pajāyāmi tayo sāle mahādhane / aññe kule na jānāmi piṇḍapātass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
thi-ap33:19.1: Bhavābhave saṃsaritvā sukkamūlena coditā / amanāpaṃ na passāmi somanassa kataṃ phalaṃ. // //
thi-ap33:20.1: Iddhīsu ca vasī homi dibbāya sotadhātuyā / cetopariyañāṇassa vasī homi mahāmune. // //
thi-ap33:21.1: Pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ / sabbāsavā parikkhīṇā n' atthi dāni punabbhavo. // //
thi-ap33:22.1: Atthadhammaniruttīsu paṭibhāne tath' eva ca / ñāṇaṃ mamaṃ mahāvīra uppannaṃ tava santike.
thi-ap33:26.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ Uppaladāyikā bhikkhunī bhagavato sammukhā imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
